signal: The old native selfhost candidate reported only a generic field-type mismatch for a UInt8 literal 256; a naive negative verifier also counted its one-line .ll diagnostic stub as emitted LLVM.
structure: A concrete integer field checks lexical literal bounds before generic type matching; nonliteral mismatches retain the former diagnostic. The focused verifier distinguishes diagnostic-only .ll stubs from LLVM, freezes both positive and negative inputs by hash, and requires 17/17 contextual, 62/62 lexical, 2/2 native exact, and 2/2 diagnostic checks under one candidate compiler SHA.
